prompt: Silent fictional small-office supply kit, six seconds, wide 16:9. Exactly four product groups stand in one straight row from left to right with clear gaps: (1) a cylindrical stainless French coffee press with a visible plunger lid and a plain ivory ceramic mug together on a plain box; (2) a clear unlabelled spray bottle with a folded fabric cleaning cloth on a plain ivory box; (3) one ordinary unbranded ergonomic task chair with a simple RECTANGULAR charcoal mesh back, a small adjustable horizontal lumbar pad, a thick rectangular fabric-padded seat, two straight adjustable armrests and a plain five-spoke star base on casters, on the floor; (4) a neat stack of loose blank white printer paper with visible sheet edges on a plain box. The chair has conventional straight rectangular forms, not a rounded oval mesh shell or a sculpted designer frame. The boxes under groups 1 and 4 are matte, muted, dark dusty grey-indigo (#44416F), desaturated, not royal blue or saturated violet. The middle box and mug are warm ivory (#F6F4EF). All packaging is blank. Locked-off static camera: no pan, orbit, push-in or cuts. Wide framing with generous empty margin on both sides; every prop and every chair wheel remains fully in frame throughout. The objects stay stationary at realistic scale. No other furniture, electronics, plants, windows or wall art in view. No writing, letters, numbers, stickers, labels, barcodes, logos, symbols, signage, prices, UI, mascots, slogans or real trade dress. No people, hands or faces. No soundtrack.
